name: ENKI Reference Data Pack
description: Manifest of locally-cached public datasets that the investigation pipeline can query without hitting the live network. Each entry in refdatapack.datasets.json describes one bulk-downloadable dataset: source URL, refresh cadence, parser, on-disk path, license, and trust class. The refdata sync worker reads this manifest to know what's available; source handlers consult the refdata_packs DB registry to decide whether a local-first lookup is current. The pack stops short of the dataset bodies themselves — those are downloaded and indexed per-operator opt-in. NAMESPACE FIX (2026-07-25): namespaces_owned was ['refdata.packs'], which did not own this pack's own definition ids; added the namespace actually used so the admission ceremony's ownership check passes.

metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.change_control: Adding a new dataset requires a corresponding parser in core/refdata/packs/<dataset_id>.py. Removing a dataset deactivates the pack but leaves the on-disk and DB records intact for one refresh cycle so in-flight queries don't see partial data.
